examples.en: By the night when it covers.

examples.ar: يَقْرَأُ الكَاتِبُ رِوَايَاتِهِ فِي هُدُوءِ اللَّيْلِ.
examples.en: The writer reads his novels in the calmness of the night.

examples.ar: اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةٌ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالمُفْرَدَاتِ وَالفَصَاحَةِ.
examples.en: The Arabic language is rich in vocabulary and eloquence.

examples.ar: عَامِلِ النَّاسَ بِاحْتِرَامٍ وَلُطْفٍ تَكْسِبْ قُلُوبَهُمْ.
examples.en: Treat people with respect and kindness, and you will win their hearts.

translation: play, game, fun / also (لَعِبَ) he played

examples.ar: وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ.
examples.en: And the worldly life is not but play and amusement.

examples.ar: كَانَ لِقَاءُ الأَصْدِقَاءِ بَعْدَ سَنَوَاتٍ طَوِيلَةٍ مُؤَثِّرًا جِدًّا.
examples.en: The meeting of friends after long years was very moving.

examples.ar: رَسَمَ الفَنَّانُ لَوْحَةً بَدِيعَةً لِلرِّيفِ فِي الرَّبِيعِ.
examples.en: The artist painted a wonderful painting of the countryside in spring.
